senses.gloss: m. pl.ḳuramé, name of a water plant bearing fruit the kernels of which can be made edible by cooking (v. Löw, Pfl., p. 202).
units: <cite ref="Eruvin 22a:2">Erub. 22ᵃ</cite> (R. Adda to his wife asking what she could do for his children during his absence at college) <he>מי שלימו ק׳ באגמי</he> (Ms. M., with slight difference of diction, <cite ref="S01188"><he>קִירָמֵי</he></cite>; Ms. O. <cite ref="S00617"><he>קוּרָאמֵי</he></cite>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) are the ḳ. in the marshes all gone?—V. <cite ref="S02097"><he>קְרָמִית</he></cite>.
